items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I used to marvel at this cat every night. Every time he played he was somethin' else.

ctx.x: Now, that was the trumpet player, what was his name, Charlie Jacobs?
Charlie Jacobs, right. He was a helluva trumpet player, too, man. I used to marvel at this cat every night. Every time he played he was somethin' else.
You told me he was quite advanced...
